Founder

Velocity Esports.
Bootstrapped from zero.

Founded May 17, 2014. I built partnerships with MLG and Quest Nutrition, and signed an MLG.tv contract before I turned 18.

Sold it. Built the team.

$1M+ in door-to-door sales. $25k/month at peak. Trained and led a team of 5–10 reps.

Top 5 global seasonal rankings in Fortnite and Halo 5.

Three clothing brands

I started HappyHerbCo, Luhu Clothing, and SummerLyfe.

Recovery community leadership

Previously a House Leader and Assistant Men’s Director at the McShin Foundation. Certified peer-to-peer counselor in mental health and addiction. That work informs why I build around accountability.

Get your
site live.

$100One-time website + launch package

$50/month maintenance

A clear place to send people, with the content and setup to launch it. Send me your idea, links, and what you want visitors to do.

Website

A mobile-friendly website with clear sections, your work or offer, and a contact or booking link. We agree the page and content scope before the build.

Launch video

A short video introducing your site or offer, made from agreed product screens, footage, and brand assets. The format and length are agreed before production.

Hosting & domain setup

I connect your domain, set up hosting, and publish the site. Initial domain and hosting costs are included for now; any future renewal costs are agreed before you incur them.

CMS

A simple content editor for the parts of the site you need to update. We agree which text, images, or posts you can edit before the build.

Maintenance — $50/month

Small text and image updates, link checks, and fixes to the delivered site. New pages, major redesigns, and extra features are quoted separately.

Social strategy

A practical launch plan covering your audience, key message, channels, and first posts. Ongoing posting and channel management are available as a separate service.

Website + launch: $100 one-time. Maintenance: $50/month. Initial domain and hosting included for now. Scope and delivery date agreed before kickoff.
